purpose: Per-cell structural ownership and deterministic mutation policy.

protectionLevels.LOCKED: Later stages may not change topology or semantic identity unless explicitly allowlisted.
protectionLevels.STRUCTURAL: Palette may resolve color; legacy polish may not rewrite the structural role.
protectionLevels.FORM: Material/form stages may change shade role within the same region.
protectionLevels.SURFACE: Surface design may decorate without changing topology.

conflictPolicy: FAIL_OR_LOG_REJECT; never resolve by accidental pass order
